preconditions.description: The number of cities n must be between 2 and 20,000.
The number of citizens m must be between 1 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= n and 1 <= u <= n and v != u for v, u in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road must connect two distinct cities within the valid range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= n and 1 <= yi <= n and xi != yi for xi, yi in citizens)
preconditions.description: Each citizen must live and work in distinct cities within the valid range.

postconditions.description: The total number of puppies k must be between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: 0 <= q <= min(m, k) and len(citizens_with_puppies) == q
postconditions.description: The number of puppies given to citizens q must be valid and match the count of citizens receiving puppies.

postconditions.expression: 0 <= e <= min(n - 1, k) and len(guardians_with_puppies) == e
postconditions.description: The number of puppies given to guardians e must be valid and match the count of guardians receiving puppies.
The sum of puppies given to citizens and guardians must equal the total number of puppies k.
